Name: Harvest_Feast_Shepherd
$Comment: Bram the Shepherd's conversation, one of the three villagers standing in the Forgotten Temple while
Harvest Feast runs. Bram contracts, and keeps it short: I'm, can't, she's.
Start's First beats come first. The off-season beat answers a visit while the feast is off (after a
command ends it, or when a server owner stands Bram somewhere all year) with one line and goodbye. A
conversation has no Season leaf, so it reads the feature ziggfreedcommon:feature Harvest_Feast_Live,
Min 1.
Quests holds two rows. Supper for Bram (harvest_feast_supper_bram), the plate Martha sends him after
The Feast, names only its Ready screen: while the player carries it with the cooked wildmeat in the
bag, the conversation opens on supper, his thanks, whose answer hands it over. Then his daily, Daily
Eggs (harvest_feast_shepherd_eggs): the conversation opens on its offer while it can be taken, on its
brief while it is carried, and on its hand-in once the eggs are in the bag. Each hand-in opens his
quest list with Collect in front of the player, and collecting plays this conversation again (each
quest's CompletionDialogue). Otherwise it opens on greeting, the Fallback. Greeting and the eggs brief
lead with What needs doing? (Open Quests: the quest list of the character in front of the player, so
his daily and his supper), then his tip on turkeys, eggs and taming (the turkeys screen). The way
into the Turkey Graveyard is Martha's (Harvest_Feast_Host.json), not his.
The invitation tour's line is not in this file: DialogueExtensions/SeasonsOfOrbis/
Harvest_Feast_Invitation.json adds it to the screens a conversation opens on while the player carries
the tour, after a screen's own lines and before the goodbye group, so goodbye stays last. That line
is spent once a day per conversation, which is why each villager has a conversation of their own.
